units.source_text: “当这个世界变成‘狗生下的婴儿是孔雀’那样的童话世界时，人类就不会感到厌倦无聊了吧。

en.t: When this world becomes a fairy-tale world where a baby born from a dog is a peacock, humanity will no longer feel weary or bored, I suppose.

units.source_text: 释迦牟尼很伟大，但是他把轮回转生为其他动物的生灵当作惩罚，这点比你肤浅。”

en.t: Shakyamuni was very great, but in treating living beings reborn through transmigration as other animals as a punishment, he was shallower than you in that respect.
